# @superinstance/starter-shell

**Starter shell** — bootstrap CLI for the SuperInstance fleet.

This npm package is a thin wrapper around the Python distribution. For full functionality, the `postinstall` hook installs the Python package via `pip install starter-shell`.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g @superinstance/starter-shell
```

(Requires Python 3.10+ and pip available on PATH.)

## Usage

```bash
starter-shell --version
starter-shell onboard
```

## Source

- Python distribution: https://pypi.org/project/starter-shell/
- Repository: https://github.com/SuperInstance/starter-shell
